search_text: published ZDI-26-198 ZDI-CAN-28324 (Pwn2Own) QNAP TS-453E malware_remover Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2026-03-16 CVE-2025-11837 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-11837 8.8 AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['QNAP'] ['TS-453E'] This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-453E devices. title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP TS-453E malware_remover Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-453E devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the malware_remover.cgi endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute Python code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
